description: Handoff contract from Archivist (refinement) to Sniper (execution). These fields are REQUIRED in the refinement artifact, regardless of format. The implementing skill decides the file format.

acceptance_checks.description: Conditions that must be true for the mission to be considered complete

allowed.description: Glob patterns of paths Sniper may touch

forbidden.description: Glob patterns Sniper must not touch

confidence_summary.description: Versioned confidence envelope preserved from Ranger and refined by Archivist. Questions remain questions unless explicitly resolved; assertion evidence references must resolve before the package is presented at the Approval Gate.

handoff_verification.description: Optional semantic handoff challenge metadata for the Archivist -> Sniper transition. This complements YAML structure validation; it never replaces the Strategist Approval Gate.

field_descriptions.task_type: Archivist classification of this item. Only documentation_target items are Sniper-executable. implementation_handoff items (code/hook/config/test mutation) must never be presented as Sniper-executable work — see 04-refinement.md and 06-execution.md.

initiative_result.description: Result emitted by the consultative INITIATIVE ability. It is validated by the next consumer but never authorizes the Approval Gate or execution. Missing evidence is represented as a confidence limit or challenge.

side_quests_approved.description: Side quest strategy decisions made by Archivist — surfaced at approval gate

field_descriptions.confidence_percent: optional, integer 0-100. Present only when investigation_required is false/absent. Never fabricate a low or placeholder value to fill this field — a side quest without enough evidence to assess is investigation_required, not a low confidence_percent.
field_descriptions.dependencies: list of other SQ ids or task ids this depends on
field_descriptions.description: brief description of the side quest
field_descriptions.id: SQ-NNN format — matches ranger handoff id
field_descriptions.investigation_required: optional boolean, default false. true means the side quest cannot be confidently assessed yet — the gate must show "precisa investigar" instead of a percentage, and confidence_percent must be omitted. This mirrors the existing claim_kind: question rule for tasks (a claim that cannot support an assertion is a question, never a guessed percent).
field_descriptions.status: sq_pending when gate opens; sq_backlog if user does not select it

stop_conditions.description: Conditions under which Sniper must stop and report, not decide
